🐉Crack the Code & Rescue the Baby Dragon

Listen... a frightened baby dragon’s cries echo in the
distance.
Night falls without warning. The invaders have set up
rune traps, leaving the baby dragon trapped inside a
cold, dangerous mechanism.
The little dragon is scared and helpless, with danger
closing in. It’s waiting for you to come to the rescue!

🔍 Find the hidden clues on the tag, team up with
your Viking companions, and race against time to
rescue the frightened baby dragon!

📝 How to Participate
1. Carefully examine the clue tag. Use the patterns,
details, and hidden hints in the image to figure out
the 4-digit code and complete the rescue puzzle.
2. Leave a comment with: [Correct Code + Server ID
+ In-Game Name]

🎁 Event Rewards
After the event ends, 10 lucky Lords will be randomly
selected from all players who submit the correct
answer. Each winner will receive a $4.99 Gold Blocks!

⏳ Event Period
October 22–29

📌 Event Tips
1. Each player may participate only once. Duplicate
entries will be considered invalid.
2. Please make sure your Server ID and In-Game
Name are correct to avoid issues with reward
delivery.
3. The list of winners will be announced after the
event ends.

Which Default Avatar Is Your Favorite?

When you first started playing Top Heroes, which
default avatar did you choose? Or is there an avatar
that left a lasting impression on you? Come share
your favorite with everyone and see who picked the
same avatar as you! If you've created your own
version of a default avatar, we'd love to see that too!

📸 How to Participate
Share your favorite default avatar or fan-made
version in the comments, along with your In-Game
Name and Server ID.

⏰ Event Duration
October 21 – October 27

🎁 Rewards
1. We'll randomly select 10 lucky Lords from all
participants. Each winner will receive a Gold reward
worth $4.99!
2. Rewards will be sent within 3 business days after
the event ends.

We can’t wait to see your favorites and all your
creative designs, Lords! ❤️
